purpose: Use historical KSEAB 15-E papers as evidence for question-bank design without treating historical distributions as the current official blueprint.
source_priority: 15-E school mid-term/term papers supplied to the project

historical_corpus.notes: 15E preparatory/model material is included as pattern evidence.
15E final and supplementary variants should be mined separately because supplementary papers provide alternative formulations.
15E Exam-2, Exam-3 and supplementary variants are part of the historical evidence set.
KSEAB 15-E Model Question Paper-1; use for current-format validation, not as a substitute for the 2026-27 blueprint.
The official 15E blueprint controls current allocation and paper-generation rules.

labels.adapted: New question adapted from a historical pattern
labels.original: New question created for English Hub

analysis_rules: Count recurring concepts separately from exact repeated questions.
Track grammar form and construction, not only topic names.
Track chapter recurrence across final and supplementary papers.
Use supplementary and Exam-2/Exam-3 papers to expand alternate formulations.
Use mid-term papers for chapter and skill coverage, not official final-exam weightage.
Never mix 14-E, 31-E or other English codes into the 15-E bank.
Never copy a historical question into a generated mock without preserving provenance.
Prefer fresh questions that reproduce KSEAB style and competency while avoiding unnecessary verbatim duplication.
